Backend Software Engineer (Python)

We are hiring a backend engineer to build and run the APIs behind our
customer-facing web app. You will design REST APIs in Python (Django or
FastAPI), model data in PostgreSQL, and ship services in Docker containers to
AWS. You will work with a small team that also maintains a React front end.

Requirements:
- 2+ years building production web services in Python
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL schema design
- Docker and Git in daily use
- Experience designing and documenting REST APIs

Nice to have:
- React or another modern JavaScript framework
- Redis or other caching layers
- AWS (ECS, RDS, S3)
- Kubernetes
